title: Your own engine login
lede: Sign in with your own account through the engine's own sign-in page. The runs you start then use it instead of the workspace's key, one at a time. Thulu never sees what the sign-in stores.
warning: Every agent container a run of yours starts can read this login. Connect a personal account only on a self-hosted install you control.
meta_connected: {who} · runs you start use this login
meta_none: Runs you start use the workspace's key

modal.title: Sign in to {engine}
modal.lede: Open the sign-in page, approve the access with your account, then paste the code it shows you here.

confirm.title: Disconnect your {engine} login?
confirm.message: The engine signs this login out and its volume is removed. Runs you start go back to the workspace's key.

errors.load: Could not load your engine logins.
